title.rendered: Kiierr Daily Omega 369 Fish Oil For Hair Growth

content.rendered:
Omega 369 supplementation may also be shown to help with the following:

  • Promote circulation in the scalp that may trigger hair growth
  • Prevent hair follicle inflammation, which is a factor (if left untreated) that can directly to hair loss
  • Provides essential proteins and nutrients to hair follicles & skin – source

This 2015 study found that women experienced a reduction in hair loss/thinning as well as increased hair density when taking supplements of antioxidants, omega-3 and omega-6 fatty acids.
